text.A: **Denne politik gælder, uanset hvor du er.** Vi følger britisk databeskyttelseslovgivning, og hvor databeskyttelseslovgivningen i det land, du bor i, også gælder, følger vi også den.
text.B: **Bemærkninger om allergi og kost.** Vi videregiver dem til foodtrucken sammen med din bestilling og bruger dem ikke til andet. Vi fjerner dem sammen med dit navn og dine kontaktoplysninger 12 måneder efter bestillingen (se afsnit 7).
text.C: **Internationale overførsler.** Dine kontooplysninger og bestillingsoplysninger opbevares og behandles i Storbritannien. Visse ting håndteres uden for landet: udtrækning af menukort og automatiske WhatsApp-svar, som bruger en Google-tjeneste i USA; levering af WhatsApp-beskeder, som håndteres af Meta i USA; betalinger, som håndteres af Stripe i USA; og pushnotifikationer, som leveres af Apple og Google i USA. Hvor oplysninger forlader Storbritannien, er overførslen omfattet af britiske tilstrækkelighedsregler (UK adequacy regulations) eller af International Data Transfer Agreement eller Addendum og, hvor lovgivningen i dit land kræver det, af en garanti, som denne lovgivning anerkender. Du kan bede os om nærmere oplysninger om de garantier, der gælder.
text.G:
Vores [servicevilkår](/terms) gælder i alle lande, hvor HatchGrab bruges. Nogle lande har yderligere regler. Denne side beskriver dem, ét land ad gangen.

Hvor et afsnit nedenfor gælder for dig, er det en del af vores servicevilkår. Hvis det siger noget andet end dem, gælder denne side for det pågældende land.

Hvis dit land ikke er nævnt, er der ingen yderligere regler: Servicevilkårene gælder, som de er skrevet. Vores [privatlivspolitik](/privacy) er den samme i alle lande.

back.A: **This policy applies wherever you are.** We follow British data protection legislation, and where the data protection legislation of the country you live in also applies, we follow that too.
back.B: **Notes about allergy and diet.** We pass them to the food truck together with your order and use them for nothing else. We remove them together with your name and your contact details 12 months after the order (see section 7).
back.C: Where data leave the UK, the transfer is covered by British adequacy rules (UK adequacy regulations) or by the International Data Transfer Agreement or Addendum and, where the legislation of your country requires it, by a safeguard that this legislation recognises.
back.D: ## 8. Your rights / Under British data protection legislation and, where it applies, the legislation of the country you live in, you have the right to: [7 bullets unchanged] / The legislation where you live may give you these rights under other names or give you additional rights. Those you have too. / **How to make a request.** Write to privacy@hatchgrab.com. We check that the request is genuine before we act on it. You can ask someone else to make the request for you, and we do not treat you differently because you make a request. We reply within one month, or faster if the legislation of your country requires it. If you ordered from a food truck, we may pass your request to that food truck, because it decides how your order details are used. If we reject a request, you can ask us to look at it again by replying to our answer. / **Deleting your account.** [old text unchanged] When an operator's account is deleted, we also remove the operator's customers' names, contact details and notes from the orders we keep. / **Marketing emails.** We send marketing emails only where the legislation where you live allows it, which in some countries means only with your consent. Each email states who it is from, contains our postal address and tells you how to unsubscribe. If you ask us to stop, we do, free of charge and within 10 working days. Emails about an order or your account are not marketing. If we or a food truck offer order updates by SMS, you get them only if you accept it, and you can stop them at any time. / **If something goes wrong.** If a personal data breach involving your personal data is likely to cause you serious harm, we notify you and the supervisory authority as quickly as possible where the law requires it, or help the food truck you ordered from to do so. / **Complaints.** Tell us first at privacy@hatchgrab.com; we would appreciate the chance to put things right. You can also complain to the data protection authority where you live. In the UK, that is the Information Commissioner's Office at ico.org.uk or on phone 0303 123 1113.
back.G: Our [terms of service] apply in all countries where HatchGrab is used. Some countries have extra rules. This page describes them, one country at a time. / Where a section below applies to you, it is part of our terms of service. If it says something different from them, this page applies for the country concerned. / If your country is not mentioned, there are no extra rules: the terms of service apply as written. Our [privacy policy] is the same in all countries.
